profile.headline: SWE @ Tesla, Ex. Coinbase, GitHub, Figma, Fiveamp
profile.summary: I’m a Software Engineer at Tesla with prior experience at Coinbase, GitHub, Figma, and Fiveamp. I specialize in backend systems, distributed architectures, cross-platform development, and general front-end development in React, with a strong foundation in Golang, React, and modern web technologies.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed frontend applications in React/TypeScript, occasionally extending into Golang backend services, delivering new MES UI features with speed and high code quality
• Acted as both engineer and UI/UX designer, creating mockups and shaping user workflows for data labeling, visualization, and manufacturing tools to improve usability and efficiency
• Supported cross-team migrations of legacy UIs into the unified MES platform, combining technical rewrites with functional upgrades to streamline user experience across the cell manufacturing organization

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Remote
positions.description:
• Developed backend services in Golang with AWS, Kafka, and gRPC in a Service Oriented Architecture codebase.
• Developed user facing metadata service used for over 1700+ user created metadata attestations within a month
with an admin approval tool and internal data ingestion through Kafka queue into a PostgresDB.
• Developed parts of the Coinbase Wallet App using React Native.
positions.insights: Skills: Blockchain · TypeScript · Datadog · React.js · React Native · PostgreSQL · Go (Programming Language) · golang · Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Improve company wide developer support and incident resolution through tools made with Copilot, Datadog, Slack, and PagerDuty APIs (GoLang, Ruby on Rails, and Typescript within Kubernetes).
• Reduced average incident and support response time by 500% through iterative tool design and implementation.
• Significantly reduced engineer hours spent on support, resulting in thousands of dollars per week saved for the in estimated wages.
positions.insights: Skills: GitHub Copilot · Slack API · Software Engineers · PagerDuty · Go (Programming Language) · golang · Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) · Ruby on Rails · Kubernetes

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Developed a new product feature streamlining insertion of Design Components (React frontend & Ruby backend).
• Sped up a hot-path database query by 23% through the implementation of caching, while adhering to the company's rollout best practices guided by production metrics.
• Collaborated closely with the designer to create several iterations of the product feature, leading to a more user-friendly experience.
• Followed engineering best practices: design doc reviews, code reviews, stacked pull requests, metrics-driven rollout using feature flags.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · TypeScript · C++ · Back-End Web Development · React.js · Git · Ruby · Communication · Algorithms · GitHub · Software Design

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented gameplay and server backend systems for mobile games in Unity 3D
• Formulated a level creation tools using C#
• Explored compute shaders which improved graphical performance
• Pitched over 15 systems and gameplay features to managers that were later implemented
• Shipped game website: https://mergecrafter.com

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
• Resolved 40+ diverse bugs within one month, supporting senior engineers
• Developed notification and daily bonus systems, enhancing user engagement and retention
• Designed and proposed a new gameplay system, later prototyping a demo for validation

projects.title: Iron Pilgrim
projects.description:
An LLM driven browser agent that can perform arbitrary browser and page navigation for the user based on a provided natural language task.

https://github.com/WojtekTB/Iron-Pilgrim

projects.title: Dino-nn
projects.description:
A set of neural networks trying to improve at the chrome dinosaur game.
* Wrote neural network models from scratch
* Implemented evolutionary algorithm
* Implemented the chrome dinosaur game
Link: https://wojtektb.github.io/projects/dino-nn
